reviews.text: Alessandra Morello's review is false. I know that cat very well, and it's not hers.

A truly positive experience! I had a wonderful time: the environment was quiet, welcoming, and designed specifically for cats. Daniela is incredibly kind, attentive, and clearly loves animals. My cat came home feeling relaxed and well-groomed. I highly recommend her.

I brought my big cat, and he was thrilled! Daniela is a true professional: sweet, patient, and attentive to every detail. My cat, who is usually a bit wary, immediately relaxed, and you could tell he was in good hands. The end result was flawless: soft, fragrant, and with gorgeous fur! I absolutely recommend her to anyone who truly loves their cats.

It was my first time taking my cat to Daniela, and I have to say it was a fantastic experience! As soon as we walked in, a calm and welcoming atmosphere immediately reigned. Daniela was able to put my usually very wary cat at ease.
With great kindness and professionalism, she took care of every detail of the grooming, explaining to me step by step what she was doing and the care she gives cats.
When I saw the result, I was enchanted: the fur was incredibly soft, fragrant, and perfectly groomed! But above all, my cat was calm, a sign that he felt safe.
Thank you so much, Daniela, for the passion and expertise you put into your work. We'll definitely be back!
I took my European dog to Daniela for the first time for a trim and nail clip. When he came home, he was super happy and clean. Well done!
I took my two Scottish Folds to Mrs. Daniela. I'm super happy with the work done on my cats. Well done!

I went to Il Persiano grooming salon to have my European longhair clipped.
The job was done with love, as my cat is a bit reluctant to be touched. The owner is wonderful!
Excellent cat grooming service in the city center. The owner is great.

I have known Daniela, from il Persiano since 1990, since my Persian was three months old, now he is 8 years old, I know for sure that I could not have found better....if you consider that I live in Anzio when I have to take Romeo and a trip, but for Daniela I would go as far as Milan, Daniela is special, you can see that she loves her job, empathetic, very professional, and above all the Cats LOVE her. Thank you Daniela.
Very fast and high-quality service. You can see a great love for animals.

I took my Persian for grooming.
I finally found someone to turn to.
Advice

I brought my two cats back to Daniela after several years because I moved out of town. They were in really bad shape, and no one wanted to clip them. Daniela was very professional and explained to me the difficulty of the job she had to do on them and the risk of not finishing the clip if the cats moved too much to avoid clipping them. I agreed because I trust her, and now my cats are super perfect thanks to her. They got clipped even though the job took longer. Thank you.
Thank you
Excellent service, attentive and precise staff, clean environment.

Work done with love and professionalism, and above all with respect for my cat.
Recommendation
I'm taking Daniela's feline grooming class. It's incredible, and after just a few lessons, I've already learned how to handle cats. Great, very good!
Daniela is excellent as always. I recommend her.
Great and super professional. I recommend it.
Excellent job done on my British Longhair. Well done. I recommend it.
The professionalism in handling the cats is amazing. Well done. Highly recommended.
Daniela is a go-to cat groomer in Rome. Excellent!
Patient and professional. Daniela, the owner, is excellent. I recommend her.
Daniela was recommended to me by acquaintances. Very satisfied. Highly recommended.
Great job on my European Championship. See you soon. I recommend it.
Great professionalism. Well done!
After much searching, I finally found a groomer who specializes in cats. Great advice!
Excellent grooming shop in Trastevere where you can take your dogs and cats. Great job, see you soon!
